info.title: Minha Livraria API
info.description: Local REST API of Minha Livraria.

tags.name: readings
tags.description: Readings of a book and their daily sessions

tags.name: goals
tags.description: Reading goals by year or month, with their progress

tags.name: reviews
tags.description: Rating and review of each book

tags.name: images
tags.description: Covers, banners and avatar saved on disk

tags.name: genres
tags.description: Genres and subgenres, at most two levels

tags.name: lists
tags.description: Lists of books made by the user

tags.name: books
tags.description: Books of the collection, registered by hand or imported

tags.name: shelf
tags.description: Read-only listing of book cards, used by every screen

tags.name: stats
tags.description: Reading statistics of the profile, calculated on every request

tags.name: profile
tags.description: Name, avatar and theme of the owner of the library

put.summary: Corrects the dates and the reread mark
put.description: The status only changes by finish and abandon. A period that leaves a session outside: 422 session.out-of-period.

delete.summary: Deletes a reading and its sessions

put.description: Same rules as creating a session.

put.summary: Changes the name and the theme
put.description: A blank name removes it: the app then greets without a name.
JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB, the same rules as the covers. The previous avatar goes to the trash.
A name already in use: 409 list.name-duplicated.

delete.summary: Deletes the list; its books stay in the collection

put.description: bookIds has to be exactly the books of the list, each one once; otherwise 422 list.invalid-order.

put.summary: Adds a book at the end of the list
put.description: Idempotent: a book that is already in the list stays where it is.

put.summary: Changes the target of a goal

delete.summary: A genre with subgenres cannot be deleted (409)

get.summary: The book page, without readings and review

delete.summary: Deletes the book and sends its images to the trash

put.summary: Marks the book as a favorite

put.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB. The previous cover goes to the trash.

put.summary: Sends the banner of the book page

get.description: A book without review: 404 review.not-found, which the front shows as "no review yet".

put.summary: Creates or rewrites the review of a book
put.description: 201 when the book had no review, 200 when it had. Rating from 1 to 5 in half points (400 validation). Without rating and without text: 422 review.empty.

get.summary: Series, by name (q ignores case and accents)
Sessions of a reading, by date

post.summary: Registers what was read on one day
post.description: Exactly one of pagesRead and currentPage (400 session.pages-mode); currentPage is converted into pages read. 422: session.page-count-required, session.out-of-period, session.exceeds-page-count and session.page-not-ahead.
A reading that is not in progress: 409 reading.not-in-progress.
A reading that is not in progress: 409 reading.not-in-progress.

get.summary: Publishers, by name (q ignores case and accents)

get.description: Sorting: name (default, asc) and updatedAt. The books of a list come from GET /shelf/books?listId={id}&sort=listOrder,asc.

post.description: A name already in use: 409 list.name-duplicated.

get.summary: Goals of a year, yearly and monthly, with the progress of each one

post.description: A second goal of the same type and period: 409 goal.duplicated. A monthly goal without month, a yearly goal with one, or rereads by month: 422 goal.invalid-period.

get.summary: Genres with their subgenres, in name order (no pagination)

post.summary: Creates a genre, or a subgenre when parentId is a genre

post.description: Duplicated ISBN-13: 409 book.isbn-duplicated, with bookId pointing to the book that already has it.

get.summary: Readings of a book, the one in progress first and then from the latest to the oldest

post.summary: Starts a reading or registers an old one
post.description: IN_PROGRESS needs startDate; FINISHED and ABANDONED need endDate. A second reading in progress of the same book: 409 reading.in-progress-exists.

post.summary: Imports an edition into the collection
post.description: Downloads the cover and reuses authors and publisher by name. Edition or ISBN-13 already in the collection: 409 book.edition-duplicated or book.isbn-duplicated, with bookId. Open Library failures: 404 openlibrary.not-found, 502 openlibrary.bad-response, 503 openlibrary.unavailable and 504 openlibrary.timeout.

get.summary: Authors, by name (q ignores case and accents)
Totals of the month and of its year, average rating, rereads, pages and streaks
get.description: Without year or month, the current ones. The streaks always count up to today.

get.summary: Pages read per day, only the days with reading
get.description: Both days included. A period that ends before it starts: 400 stats.invalid-period; more than 366 days: 400 stats.period-too-long.

get.summary: Days and pages of each book in the period, the books with more days first
get.description: Both days included. A period that ends before it starts: 400 stats.invalid-period; more than 366 days: 400 stats.period-too-long.

The search ignores accents and also matches author names. A genre brings the books of its subgenres. status can repeat. Sorting: title, author, addedAt (default, desc), seriesPosition, rating, finishedAt and, only with listId, listOrder.

get.summary: The other books of the series and the ones with subgenres in common

get.description: Served with a permanent cache and the content hash as ETag. Unknown images: 404 image.not-found.

get.summary: Searches the Open Library by title or author
get.description: Up to 20 results. libraryBookId is set when the edition is already in the collection. Open Library failures: 404 openlibrary.not-found, 502 openlibrary.bad-response, 503 openlibrary.unavailable and 504 openlibrary.timeout.

get.summary: The data of one edition, before importing it
get.description: Send exactly one of isbn and editionKey; otherwise 400 request.invalid. Nothing is saved and the cover still points to the Open Library. Open Library failures: 404 openlibrary.not-found, 502 openlibrary.bad-response, 503 openlibrary.unavailable and 504 openlibrary.timeout.
